acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

locationHistory.description: The historical location/address for the asset.

location.description: The current location/address for this asset.

description.description: A description of the physical asset.

realTimeLocations.description: Real-time location data for a moving asset.

parentRelations.description: Parent relations, where 'to' refers to this asset.

childRelations.description: Child relations, where 'from' refers to this asset.

denormAncestors.description: Ancestors in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

denormDescendants.description: Descendants in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

relativePositionHistory.description: The historical relative positions of this physical asset.

relativePosition.description: The current relative position of this physical asset.

measurements.description: Physical measurement series related to this asset.

pointMeasurements.description: Point measurement series for time-series metrics related to the asset.

events.description: The event history for this physical asset.

childSensorRelations.description:
The {@link Sensor}s associated with this {@link PhysicalAsset}.

This field establishes the relationship between the physical asset and its associated sensors,
using a filter to only include sensors in the relation (where the type of relation is 'SENSOR').

diagramRelations.description: Relations to {@link ParsableDiagram}s which have been linked to this asset.

numDiagramRelations.description: Count of {@link ParsableDiagram}s which have been linked to this asset.

title:
`PhysicalAsset` represents an asset in the physical world that may have associated sensors.

- `childSensorRelations`: This property defines the relationships between the asset and its associated sensors.
It fetches all the sensor-related hierarchical relationships linked to this physical asset, where
the sensor type is identified by `typeIdent == "SENSOR"`.
name: PhysicalAsset
